method: Monte Carlo projection of the final result. Counted votes are exact; remaining votes per county come from the expected-vote model. Remaining ballots' lean = 2024 presidential precinct baseline plus a statewide-in-district swing (prior: poll average blended with fundamentals; amendments: wide prior around 50%) updated by counted precincts, county deviations, and an uncertain late-ballot shift (sd 0.15 logit). Probabilities are capped at 1% / 99%.
